set.title: Use the sub-navigation on the AI sessions page to make V2, V3, V25 variants of the sessions list.
set.description:
- The sessions list should default to filtering by the last day or month.
- A flat grid of every session, subsession, minion and agent is noise and hides what the owner is looking for.
- Owner hasn't looked at the sessions page in a while and keeps asking for a redesign.
- Owner has asked for sessions to be nested before.
- Sessions should be nested in a parent hierarchy so the page renders grouped sessions that make sense.
